items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: a proposition came to me to do a 7 days tour with a show that was organized by Jacques Canetti... I did a recording session for Phillips records CCI of which Jacques Canetti was one of the big directors.

ctx.x: The Vieux Colombier was jumping and the young dancers had picked up long before I came to Paris on how to dance the jitterbug. The African students were the best dancers, but there were some French cats that were on the ball and gave the Africans a tight race. I don't have any idea of how long Bolling had been working at the Vieux Colombier, but his band and I finished there the 2nd of September. Claude was going to work in the club St. Germain des Prés, starting the 17th of September and he made me two…

In between the time that Bolling had to wait before opening at the club St. Germain, a proposition came to me to do a 7 days tour with a show that was organized by Jacques Canetti, whc was the booking agent that had booked Louis Armstrong's first tour in France in 1934. It was through the grace of a French drummer named Gerard Pochonet that I got this gig. I had done some gigs with Pochonet before. He spoke very good English and admired American Negro musicians. He was a go getter and nice drummer also. Bill…

The stars of this show were Felix Leclerc, a French Canadian Singer and composer and André Claveau, who was a very popular music hall and radio singer. Another person who was to become a big star later was a comedian named Fernand Raynaud.
